info.title: Audiobook Librarian API
info.description:
API documentation for the Audiobook Librarian application.

This specification covers all endpoints available in the Audiobook Librarian API v1. Authentication uses opaque Bearer tokens returned by the login endpoint.

get.summary: Get the current draft and recommendation

patch.summary: Save reviewed metadata edits (JSON merge patch)
patch.description: Merges metadata edits, records `user_edit` provenance and re-derives duplicates, targets and required decisions. Invalid values are rejected, never rewritten. A no-op edit rechecks destination availability from the stored metadata: if duplicates, destinations, policy warnings or required decisions change, the revision is bumped once and a `targets_refreshed` event is recorded; otherwise the draft is returned with the same revision. On an approved draft such a change returns 409 `approved_plan_stale` instead. Editing an approved, transferring or verifying draft invalidates its plan (`plan_invalidated` event), resets its transfer (`transfer_reset` event, uploaded bytes deleted, `transfer.state` back to `not_started`) and returns it to `awaiting_review`. `local_ai_artifacts` is not supported yet and returns 422 `local_ai_artifacts_not_supported`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted draft revision; missing returns 428 revision_required, stale returns 409 draft_revision_conflict.

409.description: Stale revision (draft_revision_conflict), draft not editable (invalid_state_transition), or a no-op edit of an approved draft whose destination recheck would change its recommendation (approved_plan_stale, details: plan_revision, current_revision; nothing is changed)

post.summary: Approve the reviewed draft and lock an immutable plan
post.description: Validates the approval against the current recommendation and stores the plan exactly as approved. Metadata must equal the reviewed recommendation for title, authors, narrators, series and genres (save edits via PATCH first) or 422 `metadata_not_reviewed` is returned. Other 422 codes: validation_failed, invalid_genre (details.suggestion), invalid_duplicate_action, invalid_target, target_incompatible, target_unavailable (the draft's destinations are refreshed first; details: candidate_id, current_revision, targets_refreshed; when targets_refreshed is true the revision was bumped and a `targets_refreshed` event recorded, so reload the draft and approve again with current_revision), invalid_file_operation, invalid_transfer_mode, invalid_cover_artifact, unknown_warning, warnings_not_acknowledged.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted draft revision; must agree with expected_revision.

409.description: Stale revision (draft_revision_conflict) or draft not awaiting review (invalid_state_transition)

post.summary: Create resumable sessions for files in the approved plan
post.description: Allowed while the draft is `approved`, `transferring` or `verifying` and its plan is live. The first call moves the draft to `transferring` (event `state_changed`) and bumps the revision (new `ETag`). Calls are cumulative and may list a subset of files; re-listing a file with the same sha256 returns its confirmed offset, so calling again after a restart is a safe resume (use a new Idempotency-Key: a replayed key returns the original offsets). A different sha256 for a file that already has a session discards its staged bytes and restarts it at offset 0 (event `transfer_file_rejected` with reason `source_changed`). Every file with bytes > 0 must be uploaded, whatever its role; zero-byte manifest files are staged by the server and never uploaded. `upload_url` is relative to the API base (`/api/v1/`). Errors: 409 `approved_plan_stale` `{plan_revision, current_revision}` when `plan_revision` is not the draft's live plan; 409 `invalid_state_transition`; 422 `unknown_file` `{file_ids}`, `upload_manifest_mismatch` `{file_id, field: bytes|sha256, expected_bytes?}`, `transfer_mode_mismatch`, `validation_failed`. Rate limited separately from chunk uploads.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted current draft revision (not plan_revision). Missing: 428 `revision_required`; stale: 409 `draft_revision_conflict`.

409.description: Draft changed since caller opened it, or the approved plan is stale

422.description: Request violates contract or import policy

head.summary: Get the confirmed resumable upload offset
head.description: 404 `upload_not_found` when no session exists for the file; 409 `invalid_state_transition` unless the draft is `transferring` or `verifying`. If the staged bytes are missing on disk the file restarts at offset 0.

204.description: Offset returned in Upload-Offset response header

409.description: The draft is not accepting uploads

patch.summary: Append a sequential chunk using tus-compatible offset semantics
patch.description: The body is written at `Upload-Offset`, which must equal the confirmed offset; otherwise 409 `upload_offset_conflict` `{expected_offset}` and nothing is written (repeating a confirmed chunk is safe). Appends to one draft are serialized under a row lock. Empty body at the confirmed offset is a no-op. When the last byte arrives the server hashes the staged file: a match marks the file uploaded (and moves the draft to `verifying` once every file is uploaded); a mismatch discards the bytes, resets the offset to 0 and returns 422 `upload_hash_mismatch` `{file_id, reason: hash_mismatch}` (event `transfer_file_rejected`). `transfer_progress` events `{file_id, bytes_received, bytes_total}` are recorded at most once per 5% step and on completion. The draft revision is bumped when a file completes or is rejected, not per chunk. No If-Match; `Tus-Resumable` is optional.

409.description: Client offset differs from confirmed server offset (`upload_offset_conflict`) or the draft is not accepting uploads

422.description: Chunk goes past the file length (`upload_length_exceeded`, details `upload_length`), completed file failed its checksum (`upload_hash_mismatch`), or Upload-Offset is missing (`validation_failed`)

post.summary: Verify complete hashes and staged layout without re-enriching metadata
post.description: Re-hashes every staged file against its expected SHA-256 and byte length, checks the staged layout (safe, unique relative paths bound to server staging) and records a `transfer_verified` audit event binding the files to draft_id + plan_revision. Sets `transfer.state` to `verified`; the draft stays `verifying` (queueing is a later step). Nothing is queued or imported and enrichment is not re-run. Repeating it once verified returns the draft unchanged. The request body is ignored. Errors: 422 `upload_incomplete` `{file_ids}`; 422 `transfer_verification_failed` `{file_ids}` (those files are reset to offset 0 and must be re-uploaded); 422 `staged_layout_invalid` `{file_ids}`; 409 `approved_plan_stale`, `draft_revision_conflict`, `invalid_state_transition`.

post.description: Admin-only. Mints a login OTP for the specified user without emailing it. The returned url is the magic-link landing page with the username and the 6-digit one-time code embedded as query parameters (?username=...&otp=...), so the same QR works with a regular camera scanner (browser to app deep link) and with the Librarian app's connect-screen scanner (token redeemed via POST /auth/otp/verify).
